name: quilting-webapp
description: A webapp exploring quilting history, techniques, geometry, and cross-cultural textile traditions

scripts.build: webpack --mode production && cd dist/cutters/files && chmod +x export.sh && for d in stl-*mm; do zip -qrX ../quilt-block-clay-cutters-${d#stl-}.zip LICENSE.txt README.md export.sh quilt_block_cutters.scad $d; done
